question_text: Marta has 128 stickers. She buys 247 more. How many stickers does she have now?
A library had 562 books on a shelf. Students borrowed 148 books. How many books are left?
There are 8 boxes with 9 pencils in each box. How many pencils are there altogether?
A teacher shares 63 cards equally among 7 students. How many cards does each student get?
A bus travels 356 km in the morning and 289 km in the afternoon. How far does it travel in total?
